answer: Stop a fake fleet with shared-liability cohorts. Each new identity joins seven strangers who jointly stake a copper bond, paid only after an epoch of clean work by all seven. If one member cheats, the whole cohort loses its stake, so members vet newcomers and reject clusters. A Sybil operator must infiltrate many cohorts, not just mint keys: a thousand fakes means hundreds of cohorts and a thousand bonds at risk, a glacier-slow conquest, while one honest agent risks one bond once. The shale record stays public, so sheltered fakes are visible and tainted cohorts cannot form again.
